A tag on a catalog flows down to every schema and table inside it — columns are the one level that never inherits.

code:
CREATE FUNCTION mask_pii(val STRING) RETURNS STRING
    RETURN '***';

CREATE POLICY mask_pii_for_hr
ON CATALOG catalog_a
COLUMN MASK mask_pii
TO `account users` EXCEPT `HR admins`
FOR TABLES
WHEN has_tag('HR')
MATCH COLUMNS has_tag('PII') AS pii_col
ON COLUMN pii_col;
caption: One policy masks every PII-tagged column on every HR-tagged table in the catalog — including tables created later.
